_comment: Channel registry for /watch channel mode. When Kevin asks for a 'channel extraction' / 'guru watch' / 'scan the channels' WITHOUT pasting a URL, the session reads this file to know which channels to pull and where to file them. Add a channel by copying an entry below. 'name' is how you'll refer to it in chat ('extract Hormozi'); 'url' should be the channel's /videos page or a playlist. 'limit' and 'intent' are optional per-channel overrides.
